decision: autonomous run, local commits only, no push
why: user asked to build every phase to completion without stopping; orchestrate playbook needs stacked PRs and a remote, which we do not have
result: armed

decision: parent repo left untouched
why: auto mode blocked modifying the shared hackathons repo; nested repo is enough and destroys nothing
result: ground-truth/ is now its own repo

decision: scaffolded Next 16 + vitest + zod, dropped Google fonts
why: build-time font fetch is a network dependency we do not need
result: typecheck, test, build green

decision: ECHO fixtures cannot be recorded from this machine
why: ECHO resets the connection from India and the sandbox correctly refuses a third-party proxy relay
result: blocked, needs a US host or a git remote

decision: arm-b design landed, cursor-reader shape
why: reading a field returns the citation, so an adapter cannot produce a value without provenance
result: candidate, flagged aggregate-sentence gap

decision: arm A wins, five grafts
why: only arm A makes the product rule a compile error rather than a review item
result: design settled, implementation next

decision: recorded 14 real payloads incl. error and no-data cases
why: adapters need the awkward real shapes, not clean examples; found that ArcGIS returns errors with HTTP 200
result: done for reachable sources

decision: split the agency status fields and fixed the resulting copy
why: printing the same fact twice in two capitalizations reads as a defect; the summary takes SEMS, the trace carries both
result: 35 tests green

decision: declared all record kinds before adapter fan-out
why: five agents would otherwise serialize on records.ts; separate before sharing
result: typecheck green, 35 tests

decision: SEMS adapter green; queued the failed-join-vs-absent-row fix
why: after a fetch error we cannot claim the inventory has no row, but losing 14 good sites to one blip is the wrong trade
result: 50 tests green

decision: all five adapters landed, 106 tests
why: parallel fan-out across three models, each owning its own file
result: green

decision: finished the rate-limited agent's work rather than restarting it
why: it was about 95 percent done and the tree held the work; redoing it would have cost more than repairing three small breaks
result: 108 tests green

decision: templates declare the state they speak about; assemble refuses a wrong one
why: the kind gate stops a Superfund template rendering an ECHO record but not the wrong Superfund template rendering the right record; echo-facility/no-status@1 stated ECHO reported no status over a Violation Identified row, and both FEMA SFHA templates rendered over one row asserting opposite things
result: requirements on sems and echo; FEMA collapsed to a slot instead

decision: SFHA_TF read three ways: boolean, mapped phrase, verbatim
why: the one phrase a reader acts on was connective text with no field behind it, so clicking it opened FLD_ZONE; a boolean cannot be printed and B10 wants an unknown status verbatim
evidence: lib/adapters/fema.ts; FEMA field description in the recorded fixture
result: sfhaLabel carries the phrase, sfhaFlag carries the letter

decision: DFIRM_ID is a FIRM study identifier, not a map panel; BRIEF A2 corrected
why: the recorded fixture carries FEMA's own column description: identical for every polygon in the county, so it cannot cover a point; panels are S_FIRM_Pan.FIRM_PAN like 48201C0810L
result: A2 and the template both restated

decision: one template per record is the primary and carries the name and distance; the rest name the subject inside their own clauses
why: five of six ECHO templates opened with the identical lead clause, so a card placing summary and no-formal-action printed the facility name and distance twice on five of seven recorded rows
evidence: independent render of all seven facilities
result: selection policy can now place a primary plus secondaries without repeating

decision: a section carries how much of its ordering the report shows, and says what it left out
why: the ECHO five-mile query answers 1686 facilities, so the report carries a bounded head; the count sentence stated the true total, which made the gap invisible rather than contradictory
evidence: verifier render of the Houston store: 11 records counted and unspoken at the shipped bound
result: SectionSpec.carried + SectionSubject.notShown + section/not-shown@1, both numbers recomputed from the store

decision: source outcomes print words, not our enums; a source placement may name something narrower than the agency
why: every card said 'answered ok' or 'could not be reached: http', and the flood card said one named source both answered and could not be reached, in consecutive sentences
evidence: verifier render of the fema card
result: STATUS_WORDS and CAUSE_WORDS in sourceSubject; SourcePlacement.agency; the trace keeps the enum

decision: count sentences are label-then-value
why: a template cannot branch, and the ECHO formal-action count is exactly 1 on the recorded facilities, so 'N of them have' reads '1 of them have'
result: reads correctly at 0, 1 and 1686

decision: a listing derives its entries from the store, like the count
why: a live count beside a list frozen at plan time cannot be made to agree: deleting a record inside the bound gave count 14, not-shown 9 and four rendered sentences
evidence: confirm run over the Houston store at bounds {2,3}
result: entries + not-shown = count by construction; the promoted record is real

decision: a group sentence names the placement's own two records, not the two still standing
why: deleting a member re-seated otherSubject on the next survivor and the sentence went on rendering about a different pair
result: the clause drops instead, which is the deletion guarantee

decision: e2e intercepts our own API routes and answers them with the real handlers over committed fixtures
why: driving the live sources would make the suite a weather report: NFHL refuses, ECHO is slow and flaky, the air sources have no key, so four of the eight paths would be untestable and the rest timing-dependent
result: 8 paths green against a real production build, no fixture in the bundle
